{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers, completed status, converted, and remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') &
    (sales['converted'] == 1) &
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed, non-refunded orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
